airsleek.p: Air flows through the plates, so hair dries and smooths at once.
Use it straight after the towel in wet mode, or on dry hair for touch-ups.
Thermostatic control with a clear display. Set the heat your hair needs.
Negative ions help keep frizz down for a sleek, glossy finish.
A lock button keeps it closed. The cord turns with you as you style.

airwave.p: The conical barrel wraps each section with air for soft, defined curls. Set them with the cool shot.
The diffuser spreads the airflow gently over natural curls and waves for shape with less frizz.
The pre-styling dryer takes hair from wet to dry with focused, high-speed air from a 1500 W motor.
Firm bristles hold tension while warm air smooths each section straight.
The round brush adds body at the roots and soft bends at the ends.
Long, wide teeth glide through thick or curly hair to smooth it as it dries.
